explication: This repository implements dbt’s Docusaurus-powered documentation site. Readers browse documentation and version-specific material; the version catalog and React context support version selection and URL persistence. The site also includes quickstart-guide browsing, blog and community-feedback experiences, and plugins for transforming content, including an LLM-oriented Markdown conversion pipeline. The README documents Markdown-based authoring and versioned, single-sourced content. Source excerpts are partial, so links between unsampled site features and their runtime entry points are omitted where the wiring is not shown.
